design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY / VINTAGE ARCHIVE & SWISS PRECISION
theme_strategy: Warm heritage parchment background with dark charcoal typography, warm terracotta/amber accents, and crisp modern interactive node cards.

scales.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1C2024]
scales.caption: text-xs font-mono text-[#687076]

layout_and_spacing.header_banner: Full width header with high quality vintage family photograph frame, title, search filter bar, focus history breadcrumbs, and user auth/admin buttons.
layout_and_spacing.tree_canvas: Interactive infinite/pan-zoom canvas or responsive grid tree view with SVG flow connectors (curved orthogonal lines or clean arrow lines).
layout_and_spacing.node_card: Rounded rectangle card with min-w-[160px] to max-w-[220px], px-4 py-3, rounded-xl, border shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer.
layout_and_spacing.modal_dialog: Clean centered dialog with back-navigation, full biographical profile, life timeline (birth/death dates, locations, spouses, children, parents), and edit button for contributors.

key_features_implementation.interactive_tree_canvas: Render hierarchical family tree centered on current focus node. Display parents above, current person + spouse in center, children below. Support clicking node to re-center tree.
key_features_implementation.node_hover_dates: Tooltip or inline date popover for logged in users showing birth date and death date.
key_features_implementation.detailed_person_modal: Triggered when clicking top/focused person node. Displays detailed info modal with back button to previous tree view state, full timeline, and relationship shortcuts.
key_features_implementation.auth_system: JWT auth with public guest mode, contributor role (can propose changes), and admin role (can approve/reject proposals).
key_features_implementation.contributor_portal: Form to add child, parent, spouse, or update person details. Submissions saved as 'pending' for admin review.
key_features_implementation.admin_dashboard: Review pending changes queue, compare proposed diff with current data, approve or reject with feedback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the clean rounded rectangle node aesthetic inspired by puskarcik.com with prominent ♂ and ♀ symbols.

Ensure all interactive components have unique data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='node-person-1', data-testid='tree-recenter-btn', data-testid='person-detail-modal', data-testid='admin-approve-btn').
Use standard SVG elements for connecting arrows/lines between nodes so layout adjusts dynamically based on active focus node.
Maintain high accessibility contrast ratio between node background and person names.
Provide quick demo buttons for Guest, Contributor, and Admin logins in the navbar for smooth testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_id_convention: All buttons, inputs, modals, cards, and links must include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not use transition: all globally. Apply targeted transitions on opacity, colors, border-color, and box-shadow.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.header_styling: Header must have semi-opaque background with backdrop-blur, never transparent.
